utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure thing — I’m happy to go over the club dues with you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m a little late, but can you remind me how much the dues are and when they’re due?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — the dues are $25, and they’re due by the end of the month. If that’s tricky, just let me know and we can figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Hana, what’s the latest on the club dues?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t checked the latest details yet, so I’d rather confirm before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries — can you check and let me know the amount when you get a chance?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check who’s paid and who still owes on the club dues.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Cleo — I might’ve missed a few names. If you could check, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll take a look and let you know who’s paid up and who still owes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t sorted mine yet—what’s the dues amount again?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It’s $20 this month, and I’d rather not miss the deadline—do you want me to check when it’s due?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes please, that’d help a lot—thanks, Pia.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell — are the club dues due this week, and how much is it this time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure, but I heard they might be due this week. I can check with someone and let you know the amount.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — could you check and tell me as soon as you can? I just want to know the amount and the due date.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the club dues are due soon, I think, but I’d want to double-check the amount before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can help check the amount if you want — I’ve got the last notice handy somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Gus — if you can find it, I’ll take a look and we can make sure we’ve got the right amount.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll pass the word along that the club dues are due soon, and if you want, I can help remind a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be helpful. I’ll note who’s been reminded and keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll let a few folks know today and send them your way. Just tell me who you’ve already reminded so I don’t repeat it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with that. What do you need to know about the dues?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, how much are the dues and when are they due?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m not sure of the exact amount offhand, but I can check and get back to you. If you want, I can also find out when they’re due.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m happy to sort out the club dues with you. If you’d like, I can go over the amount and the payment options now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — just give me the amount and how I can pay.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The dues are $20 for the month, and you can pay me in cash or by transfer. If either works better for you, I can take care of it right now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll repeat the dues plan to everyone and make sure it’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that’ll help. Just keep it simple and let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and pass along any updates if the dues change.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the club dues. I may have mixed up the amount, but I’ll check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I appreciate you checking—just let me know when you know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I will, Uli—thanks for your patience. I’m on it and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm the right amount.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help sort out the dues details if you want—what part is still unclear?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules—I'm just trying to confirm how much is due and when it needs to be paid.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I can check the exact amount and the deadline for you. If you want, I’ll also see whether there’s a grace period or payment option.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll pass the word around about the dues and let everyone know what’s needed. If you want, I can also help remind folks before the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be really helpful. I’ll try to get my dues in before the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No problem at all — I’ll start reminding people and keep an eye on the deadline. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest on the dues yet—what’s the amount and when do they need it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s $25, and it’s due by Friday. If that changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps — I’ll make sure to have it by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what are the club dues, and when do they need to be paid?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — the dues are $20 for this month, and they’re due by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Got it — I’ll make sure it’s paid by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I heard the dues are up for the club—want to go over them together and see what makes sense?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, let’s go over them together—I’ll keep it simple and repeat the plan back so we’re on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—thanks, Vik. Let’s start with the total due, then we can split it into the part for this month and any one-time fee.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia — how much are the club dues this time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we should confirm the exact amount and due date first, just so there aren’t any mix-ups.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good call — I’ll check the exact amount and due date before we pay.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the dues info posted yet, Rosa — do you know where they’re collecting it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll post the dues info today, Opal — we’re collecting them at the community center desk this week.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll check the community center desk this week.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Hana, how much are the club dues this month?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the amount before I tell you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, take your time—just let me know when you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—what do you need to know about the dues?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I just want to make sure we’ve got enough on hand and that everyone’s dues are marked paid. Do you know if there’s anything still outstanding?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help check that—if you’ve got the list, I’ll see who still owes and what’s already paid.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the dues are going up a bit—do you know when they’re due?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I’m not sure—I think they said something about next week, but I may have missed the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I'll ask around and see if I can confirm the exact due date. Thanks for the heads-up!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, just to confirm, the club membership dues are due this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s right — they’re due this week.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — thanks for confirming.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, I heard the club dues are still due this week—do you know where we can pay them?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I think we pay at the clubhouse desk. I can check for sure and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that’d be great—I’m running by there later, so just let me know if it’s still the desk.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the club dues. I’m sorry, Leo, I keep forgetting, but I’ll get that sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren. Just let me know when it’s handled.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I will, Leo. I’m going to take care of it today and let you know as soon as it’s done.
